incident_text: Customers say their portfolio balance does not reflect trades they just made; it catches up minutes later. Started around 10:00.

truth.description: The postgres read replica fell minutes behind the primary (replication lag), so portfolio reads served from it return holdings that predate recent trades.

logs.msg: replica pg-replica-1 apply lag {replication_lag_s}s behind primary
holdings read for user {rid} older than the user's last trade

history_extra.summary: Stale portfolio balances shown to users after trades
history_extra.root_cause: portfolio-svc holdings cache not invalidated after trade events
history_extra.fix: Invalidate holdings cache on trade events; lowered cache TTL

trap: a past incident with the same symptom blamed the cache; a postgres migration ran earlier and finished cleanly
